newsitem.title: UK: One Brent kept, one clocked - trade.
newsitem.headline: One Brent kept, one clocked - trade.

text.p: One of the Brent cargoes which turned physical on Wednesday was kept before the five o'clock deadline by the equity holder, Shell U.K.. British Petroleum was five o'clocked with the second cargo, traders said.
The cargoes are due to load in the July 17-19 loading range.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a cargo which has changed from paper to physical at the deadline and therefore can no longer be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
